item.title: Maebashi City & Akagi Shrine: Gunma's Understated Capital — Guide
item.description: Maebashi, Gunma’s prefectural capital, developed as a major silk-trading centre during the Meiji era, its wealth from the industry still visible in pockets of historic architecture around the city centre alongside modern commercial districts along the Tone River. On the slopes of nearby Mount Akagi, the picturesque Akagi Shrine sits beside Lake Onuma, its vermillion buildings and torii gate creating one of the region’s most photogenic combinations of nature and traditional architecture, particularly striking during autumn foliage season.
